scope: Adds customer-requested WhatsApp cancellation and rescheduling to the confirmed booking boundary. The reasoning provider can classify intent and an optional date/timezone only; it receives no executable tool and can never supply an appointment identifier.

Server code resolves exactly one future confirmed appointment for the conversation lead and requires it to remain with the currently assigned published advisor. Zero or multiple eligible appointments stop with a deterministic staff-help message.

Cancellation requires a separate exact six-digit confirmation. Rescheduling first offers up to three current server-computed slots while excluding the existing appointment, then requires the same separate confirmation. The existing appointment remains unchanged until confirmation commits.

Staff and WhatsApp changes use the same idempotent version, calendar revision, slot revalidation and database exclusion-constraint path. The existing published permission and WHATSAPP_BOOKING_ENABLED deployment switch remain the dual default-off gate.

securityAndConsistency.identity: Change requests are tenant/channel/lead/conversation/source-event/ownership-version bound. The server stores the selected appointment ID and expected version; model output and customer messages cannot choose an appointment record.
securityAndConsistency.confirmation: Cancellation requests and selected reschedule slots expire after 15 minutes. Reschedule offers expire after 30 minutes. Codes are stored only as SHA-256 digests and expire after five failed attempts.
securityAndConsistency.atomicity: The inbound confirmation, shared appointment mutation, immutable mutation result, lead timeline note, change-request state and outbound result are committed in one tenant transaction. Duplicate confirmation receipts replay the committed result without a second mutation.
securityAndConsistency.conflicts: Final confirmation revalidates appointment version/status/future time, advisor, calendar revision and exact slot. Staff edits or competing reservations make the request expire without sending a false success.
securityAndConsistency.ambiguity: If a lead has no upcoming appointment, more than one upcoming appointment, or an appointment outside the current assignment boundary, Sophia does not mutate anything and directs the customer to staff.
securityAndConsistency.ownership: Takeover and other ownership-version changes cancel active requests. Dispatch rechecks the request, appointment version/status, bot ownership, opt-out, open messaging window and current dual-gate configuration; terminal result messages may still report an already committed outcome.
securityAndConsistency.providerBoundary: No provider receives appointment IDs, availability tools or mutation tools. Intent output is validated against a strict allowlist and all authority remains server-owned.

deployment: Apply migration 123 with the normal Runtime migration-owner process after migration 122.
Deploy the Runtime image, Business Manager backend/reply worker and frontend together, then restart the reply worker so the new reasoner contract and outbox columns are active.

Keep WHATSAPP_BOOKING_ENABLED and the published appointment permission limited to the approved environment. No new switch is required: the existing booking permission now clearly covers confirmed booking and changes.
Verify cancellation, wrong-code, reschedule selection, stale-version conflict, duplicate confirmation and multiple-appointment ambiguity on the test number before a customer pilot.
